summary.text: Owen Werner is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 9B, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the August 11 Democratic primary.
He is an accounting manager and a graduate of Hamline University.

paragraphs.text: Owen Werner earned a high school diploma from Perham High School and a bachelor's degree from Hamline University in 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in rural Minnesota his whole life and wants to be a voice for rural Minnesotans at the Capitol.
He named the economy and affordability as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
